title: Interfaces
explain: An interface lists methods, and any type that has those methods satisfies it automatically, with no `implements` keyword. Functions that accept an interface work with every type that fits. Keep interfaces small, often just one method.
exercise: Add a `Triangle` type with an `Area` method and include it in the slice without changing the `Shape` interface.
tip: Define interfaces where they are used, not where the types live. A small interface next to the function that needs it is easiest to satisfy.
